theme.name: Bibliothèque secrète nocturne
theme.description: An immersive, elegant, and slightly mysterious web application acting as an interactive encyclopedia for spirituality, mysticism, occultism, and legends. Avoids kitsch 'TikTok witch' aesthetics, focusing instead on the atmosphere of entering a huge, secret, dimly-lit victorian library. Think deep night blue, discreet copper gilding, elegant serif fonts, and paper/velvet textures.

rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary headings, emphasizing an editorial, ancient book feel.
Use EB Garamond for long-form narrative text to ensure high legibility while maintaining the historical theme.
Use a modern clean sans-serif (like Manrope or Inter) for small UI elements like buttons, badges, and tiny labels for modern usability.
Headings should have tight letter spacing, and small overlines should be widely tracked.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise/grain texture overlay (using a pseudo-element or SVG filter) to the main background to simulate old paper/velvet without overwhelming the content.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use delicate 1px solid borders with low opacity copper (--primary) to divide sections and frame cards, mimicking book panels.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep, ambient drop-shadows rather than harsh box-shadows. Use soft glow effects for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Avoid completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Use crystal glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050814]/80 with a 1px copper border.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky navigation and modals to ensure text readability.

layouts.general_spacing: Use generous padding (p-8, p-12, p-16) to create 'breathing room' typical of high-end editorial design.
layouts.grid_system: Use The 'Bento' Grid Protocol for the 7 universes navigation. Asymmetrical grid layouts (e.g., col-span-full for hero, col-span-4 for smaller cards) to prevent monotonous layouts.
layouts.navigation: A persistent top navigation bar featuring the logo, key links (Universes, Timeline, Map), and a 'Library/Favorites' icon. Must use glassmorphism if sticky.
layouts.hero_section: Immersive 'Secret Library' entrance. Large typography, background image of a dark library with an elegant vignette overlay (bg-black/60 to transparent), and a prominent CTA 'Entrer dans la bibliothèque'.

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis is highly recommended to give the site momentum and weight.
motion.transitions: Use slow, elegant fade-ins and slight vertical translations for entrance animations (e.g., opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-4 to 0 over 0.8s).
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards should have a subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and a slight increase in border opacity or inner glow. No erratic or bouncing animations.

component_rules.badges: Used to denote story status (Fait historique, Tradition, etc.). Pill-shaped, subtle background color, crisp text. Font: Manrope.
component_rules.buttons: Elegant, either solid copper with dark text or outlined copper with copper text. Use sharp edges or slight rounding (rounded-sm) rather than fully pill-shaped.
component_rules.cards: For articles/stories: 1px border of muted copper, background is background_card, padding p-6. Never use harsh white backgrounds. Add a subtle hover state.
component_rules.timeline: A vertical or horizontal scrolling timeline for historical events. Use Framer Motion to reveal items as they enter the viewport.

hero_library.description: Moody interior shot of a dark library with a spiral staircase, used as the landing page hero background.

category_esotericism.description: Antique books and a wooden ladder, suitable for the history of esotericism section.

category_mysteries.description: Geometric copper deer skull in a glass dome, suitable for mysteries and curiosities.

interactive_map.description: Detailed view of an antique world map, can be used as a background for the map section.

category_legends.description: Vintage display of curiosities, representing myths and legends.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If more images are needed, use these provided URLs as backgrounds with heavy vignette (bg-black/50) to ensure text contrast.

3d_libraries.particles: Consider using TSParticles for a very subtle 'floating dust' effect in the hero section to emphasize the ancient library atmosphere. Keep opacity very low (e.g., 0.1).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all copper/gold text against the dark blue background meets at least WCAG AA standards (4.5:1).
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to the interactive map, timeline nodes, and the 'Tell me something strange' random button.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='random-story-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Update /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js to include the custom font families and the new colors. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables under the dark theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import Cormorant Garamond, EB Garamond, and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Opt for thin, elegant strokes (strokeWidth={1.5}).
instructions_to_main_agent.pages_to_build: 1. Home (Landing with Hero, 7 Universes Grid), 2. Story Detail Page (with Status Badge and text), 3. Interactive Timeline/Map section, 4. 'Tell me something strange' modal/page.
instructions_to_main_agent.features: Implement the 'Vrai, croyance ou légende ?' quiz component and a 'Favoris' state.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡�🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
